text_block_list.text:
While taking a break in the cafeteria,
I saw Nice Nature watching a boisterous
group
of Umamusume from a distance.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Sparkling conversations and beaming
smiles.
Yes, yes,
this is what an early afternoon at Tracen
Academy is all aboutâ

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Natureeeee!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Just another afternoon at Tracen Academy,
huh.
What is it, Turbo? What's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Listen! Turbo's gonna
do some 'ad-ver-tising'!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
The thing Teio and McQueen
are gonna do soon!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Ah~! Come to think of it, those two 
were shooting a promo for the academy,
right?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Doing promo work is, like,
peak flashy vibes.
...Seriously, it's so amazing~.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
If Teio's gonna do it,
Turbo's gonna do it too!
So Turbo's gonna promote the academy!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I see. You just want to copy them.
Weeell, I don't really get it,
but knock yourself out.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Don't just 'good luck' me!!
You're doing this with me, Nature!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, what?!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
C'mooon! Pleeaaase!
Let's hand out flyers together~!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Gahh... You're so persistent!
I told you I'm not doing it!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Why, why, whyyy?!
Turbo wants Nature to come too!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Nature's reliable,
plus she's super fun and funny!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Those two already said okay!
Nature,
you definitely have to come toooo!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Let's wear cool outfits like Teio's
and take photos~!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Urk...
Talk about pushy...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I'm telling you, it's really not like me.
Man, what am I supposed to—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Hey, Trainer, you there!
Can't you do something about Turbo!?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Hey, Trainer, you there!
Can't you do something about Turbo!?
choice_data_list: ...Why don't you try doing some pr...
Forcing things isn't good, you know.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what!?
If you say that—
choice_data_list: ...Why don't you try doing some pr...
Forcing things isn't good, you know.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Nature, Nature!!
Give it a try, give it a tryyyy!!!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
See, now she's gotten carried away!
There's no stopping her once she gets like
this...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaargh, fine, I get it, just calm down!
I'll do it, alright? I'll do it!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Yaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...I'm definitely making you take
responsibility later
for egging them on, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Coercion?!
What's coercion?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Forcing someone to do something they don't
want to do!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat?! Nature,
did you not wanna do the promo?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh. That's—
Of course I'd hate that.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Uuuugh,
you really don't want to... What a bummer.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...I feel bad for Turbo,
but that really helped.
Now things can finally go back to peace and
quiet~...
